notes.title: Row Divers Changelog V1
notes.content:
🆕  [b]NEW FEATURES[/b]
[list]
[*]     Shift to Sprint: Enable and disable running by pressing Shift.
[*]     Numpad Support: Control abilities and switch shooting modes with your numpad.
[/list]

🔧 [b]FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
[list]
[*]     Settings Persistence: Resolved issues with settings not saving correctly.
[*]     Balance Tweaks: Porcupine and Impact Armor effectiveness increased.
[*]     Cost Reductions: Lower costs for Shoot on Hold and Auto Shoot.
[/list]
